Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.securitycenter

Class AuditEvent

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.securitycenter.AuditEvent
public class AuditEvent extends Object
One entry in the Security Center's append-only activity log: when it happened, a short category and a human message. The hub records what it observed or did - a scan finished, the host posture was read, private (Tor) mode changed state, the network was cut or restored, a VPN tunnel came up or went down, definitions were updated - so there is an auditable trail beside the scan history.

A plain Jackson bean persisted by SecurityCenterStore (no-arg constructor plus getters/setters, no process or file handle), so the log round-trips as JSON and a corrupt file degrades to empty rather than throwing. It holds no secrets and no scanned content - only the category and a short description of the event.
